Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the MAP draft. A few quick clarifying questions from our security and procurement teams so we can lock the timeline:

- SOC 2: can you confirm the date range your report covers and whether the set includes an independent auditor statement we can attach to our records?
- SIG/CAIQ: do you have an existing completed CAIQ or SIG report we can review, or do you expect evidence collection from us?
- DPA / retention: our legal ops needs to confirm the maximum data retention you require for logs and temporary request data (we often must align with APAC data residency rules). Is Redwood proposing 90 days by default or are there options?
- Who on the Redwood side will be the point owner for evidence intake and DPA redlines? We want a single contact to push items to.

Target: HarborPay would like to complete the security clearance and sign the MAP so engineering can begin a scoped POC the week of Jul 20. Is that feasible?

Appreciate a quick reply — we prefer to lock dates this week.

Best,
Alex Martin
Head of Integrations
HarborPay

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

High level: goal of Redwood MAP is to clear security/compliance gates by Jul 10–16 so HarborPay can start POC the week of Jul 20. We can hit that if evidence intake and DPA redline review happen this week and next.

Short answers:
- SOC 2: we have a Type II report for period Apr 2024–Mar 2025 with an independent auditor statement. Ill attach a stub for intake; Marissa will own the SOC 2 package.
- SIG/CAIQ: we maintain a completed CAIQ (answers + evidence pointers). We can provide the CAIQ PDF and a spreadsheet of where evidence lives.
- DPA / retention: Redwood supports configurable retention tiers (30 / 90 / 365 days) for transient request data and logs. Default for APAC customers is 90 days. If HarborPay requires <90 or stricter residency, we can document an exception in the MAP.
- Owners: Marissa Cole (SOC 2 + evidence packaging), Neha Kapoor (DPA legal & redlines), Priyom Das (evidence intake & engineering coordination). I will be overall MAP steward.

Action items I propose now:
1) I will share a MAP_Roadmap_v1.xlsx (attached) with milestone dates and owners.
2) Marissa will upload the SOC2 stub and CAIQ reference by EOD Thu.
3) Neha will send proposed DPA redlines and a short note on retention carveouts by Mon Jun 22.
4) Priyom will schedule a 30-min evidence intake call (ideally Fri Jun 19) — please share availability.

If that works, well aim to have legal sign-off and security review complete by Jul 12 so contracts can be signed the following week.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee

Quick note and attachments from the security packaging side.

- Attached: SOC2_Report_Q1_2025.pdf (stub) — contains auditor statement and reporting period (Apr 2024–Mar 2025). This is what we typically provide during intake.
- Attached: Draft_DPA_redlines.docx (stub) — initial redlines from Legal that reflect our standard APAC-friendly retention defaults.
- CAIQ: Ive uploaded the CAIQ reference doc to the shared Drive (link in the MAP folder). The CAIQ includes pointer tags ("evidence-id") that match entries in the MAP_Roadmap spreadsheet.

Retention notes (summary):
- Transient request data (non-persistent): default 90 days (APAC).
- Request logs / trace spans: default 365 days for customers that need extended traceability; otherwise 90.
- Embedding/Model output: we do not persist user content beyond serving unless customer explicitly opts into storage for fine-tuning.

Open questions for HarborPay ops/legal:
- Are you OK with 90-day transient retention as the initial baseline? If not, please indicate target (30/90/365).
- Any residency constraints (e.g., data must not leave APAC)? If so, well mark that as an acceptance clause and engage Private deployment options.

I can make a redline pass on the DPA doc if HarborPay shares their preferred clause set; otherwise our draft is ready for review.
